C0677.title: From JS Map Leak to OSS Bucket Takeover: A Classic Case Study
C0677.summary: During a penetration test, analysts recovered Vue source code from a leaked frontend JavaScript map file of a mini-program. By auditing the API logic, they discovered a hardcoded endpoint exposing Alibaba Cloud OSS credentials.
